title: Event-log rotate and rechain bypass the runtime write lock
description: Evidence: FileEventLog.append computes/caches head and appends without the rotate lock, store writes hold state.lock, storage rotate-log uses only events.jsonl.lock, and doctor --fix rechain is not coordinated with store writes. Impact: rotate/rechain can interleave with active writers, losing entries or creating broken/forked chains.
acceptanceCriteria: Event-log append, rotate, and rechain share one workspace write lock or documented lock order.
Concurrency tests cover write-vs-rotate and write-vs-rechain with verifyDeep remaining green and event seqs unique.
